notes: The programme page (https://www.hs-furtwangen.de/en/programmes/international-engineering-bachelor/) states Application deadline: 31 August, but does not give a year; we have interpreted this as 31 August 2026 based on the context of the 2026/27 academic year. The DAAD page states 15 July. Tuition is stated per semester; the amount 1500 EUR is for non-EU students. Application channel: the Smart Admission page indicates direct application via email contact, not uni-assist; we quote the direct contact phrase. Some requirements (e.g., German language skills, subject-specific requirements) are not included because they are not stated as mandatory for this programme or are for German-taught tracks.

note.fr: Vérifiez si votre diplôme marocain donne un accès direct à l'université allemande via la base de données DAAD ; sinon, une année d'études ou un Studienkolleg peut être nécessaire.
note.en: Check if your Moroccan diploma allows direct access to German university via DAAD database; otherwise, one year of studies or a Studienkolleg may be required.

evidence.quote: If the database indicates that you are required to take the “Feststellungsprüfung”, direct equivalency is not granted. In that case, you would typically need to complete either one year of university studies in your home country or a one-year preparatory course in Germany (Studienkolleg) to qualify for admission to a bachelor’s programme in Germany.
